title.zh: 阿里QwenGyre将2.4T模型强化学习耗时缩短44%
title.en: 阿里QwenGyre将2.4T模型强化学习耗时缩短44%

current_state.zh: Alibaba's Qwen team introduced QwenGyre, an agent RL framework that dynamically switches GPU roles and shares trajectory history, cutting 2.4T-model reinforcement learning time by roughly 44% while improving NL2RepoBench pass rates from 52.48% to 58.54%.
current_state.en: Alibaba's Qwen team introduced QwenGyre, an agent RL framework that dynamically switches GPU roles and shares trajectory history, cutting 2.4T-model reinforcement learning time by roughly 44% while improving NL2RepoBench pass rates from 52.48% to 58.54%.
